description_en: Creates a pay-as-you-go or subscription cloud phone instance group. An instance group can manage multiple instances. Instances with the same functional roles can be grouped into the same instance group for unified management
description_zh: 创建按量付费或包年包月的云手机实例组。一个实例组可以管理多个实例。可以将具有相同功能定位的实例编入同一个实例组，以便于统一管理
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic create-android-instance-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-group-spec acp.basic.small --image-id imgc-06zyt9m93zwax0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAndroidInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the list of regions where cloud phones are available
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)查询云手机支持购买的地域列表
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the instance group.

The name can be up to 30 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain only Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
实例组名称。

实例组名称长度不超过30个字符；请以大/小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头，仅支持中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: instance_group_name

parameters.help_en: The number of instances in the instance group. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 实例组中的实例数量。最大值为100
parameters.name: number_of_instances

parameters.help_en: The billing method
parameters.help_zh: 计费类型
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration of the resource. The unit is specified by PeriodUnit
parameters.help_zh: 购买资源的时长，单位由PeriodUnit指定
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration
parameters.help_zh: 购买资源的时长单位
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The specifications of the instance group. You can call the [DescribeSpec](~~DescribeSpec~~) operation to query the available specifications for cloud phones
parameters.help_zh: 实例组规格。可以通过调用[DescribeSpec](~~DescribeSpec~~)查询云手机支持购买的规格
parameters.name: instance_group_spec

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动付费。默认为false
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自动续费。默认为false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The network ID.

To create a shared network instance: The network ID is optional. Enter the network ID of the Shared Network type on the Cloud Phone Console > Network (https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network) page. If no shared network is available in the console, you can leave this parameter empty, and automatic creation of a shared network is triggered when the instance group is created.

To create a VPC network instance: The network ID is required. Enter the network ID of the VPC Network type on the Cloud Phone Console > Network (https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network) page. If no VPC network is available in the console, you must create a network first
parameters.help_zh:
网络ID。

创建共享网络实例：网络ID选填。填写云手机控制台>网络 (https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network)页面中类型为共享网络的网络ID。如果控制台没有共享网络，可以不用填写，将会在创建实例组时自动创建一个共享网络。

创建VPC网络实例：网络ID必填。填写云手机控制台>网络 (https://wya.wuying.aliyun.com/network)页面中类型为VPC网络的网络ID，如果控制台没有VPC网络，则需要先创建网络
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448774.html operation to query the vSwitch list.

To create a shared network instance: Leave this parameter empty.

To create a VPC network instance: The vSwitch ID is required. This vSwitch is used to create the instance
parameters.help_zh:
交换机 ID。可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448774.html查询交换机列表。

创建共享网络实例：不填写。

创建VPC网络实例：交换机 ID 必填。选用此交换机来创建实例
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The policy ID. You can call the [ListPolicyGroups](~~ListPolicyGroups~~) operation to query the policy list
parameters.help_zh: 策略ID。可以通过调用[ListPolicyGroups](~~ListPolicyGroups~~)查询策略列表
parameters.name: policy_group_id

parameters.help_en: The image ID. You can call the [DescribeImageList](~~DescribeImageList~~) operation to query the image list for cloud phones
parameters.help_zh: 镜像ID。可以通过调用[DescribeImageList](~~DescribeImageList~~)查询云手机的镜像列表
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The number of instance groups. Default value: 1. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 实例组数量，默认值为1，最大值为100
parameters.name: amount

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable GPU acceleration
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启GPU加速
parameters.name: gpu_acceleration

parameters.help_en:
The key pair ID. When creating an instance group, if you specify a valid key pair ID, the key pair is bound to all successfully created instances, and you do not need to call the binding API operation again.

Binding key pairs during scale-out is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
密钥对ID。创建实例组的时候，如果指定了合法的密钥对ID，会在这次创建成功的实例上，都绑定该密钥对，不用再重新调用绑定接口。

目前还不支持扩容的时候绑定密钥对
parameters.name: key_pair_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate requests. The token can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。不超过100个字符
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
The Billable methods of the bandwidth plan. Valid values:

<props="china">

PayByBandwidth (default): pay-by-bandwidth.
PayBy95: pay-by-traditional-95th-percentile. By default, IPv6 Internet bandwidth does not support the pay-by-traditional-95th-percentile billing method. To use this billing method, contact your account manager.

</props>
<props="intl">

PayByBandwidth (default): pay-by-bandwidth.

</props>
fields.help_zh:
带宽包的计费方式。取值：

<props="china">

PayByBandwidth（默认值）：按带宽计费。
PayBy95：表示按传统95计费。IPv6公网带宽默认不支持按传统95计费，如需使用，请联系客户经理申请。

</props>
<props="intl">

PayByBandwidth（默认值）：按带宽计费。

</props>
